[[File:Gree_CoD.jpg|thumb|right|150px|CC-1004 with Double stripe hairstyle]]
The '''double stripe''' was a type of hairstyle worn by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="CoD decoded">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness|d=y}}</ref> To wear the double stripe, troopers would have all hair on their head shaved, save for two thick, parallel stripes that ran from the front to the back of their head. The two stripes met in a curve at the base of the trooper's skull, making the term "double stripe" a misnomer, as the troopers were in fact wearing a single, lengthy curve of hair atop their heads.<ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> This hairstyle was popularized in the Grand Army as an expression of honor towards a trooper's fallen comrades. [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone trooper commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] wore his dyed-red hair in this style as a tribute to his brothers-in-arms who had been lost at the [[Battle of Tibrin]].<ref name="CoD decoded" /> The clone trooper [[Boost/Legends|Boost]] also sported the double stripe,<ref name="RM">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> as did several troopers serving under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]] and the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="TCWf" /><ref name="WF">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The double stripe was developed as one way to differentiate the many clone troopers introduced in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="clonesvideo">{{SW|url=video/the-clone-wars-the-clones-are-coming|text=The Clone Wars: The Clones are Coming}}</ref> The hairstyle was first seen in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], but not named until the ''Decoded'' airing of the ninth episode in the series, [[Cloak of Darkness]].
